The gate's designs as its snapshot `bom2-5989d50` recorded them: commit `5989d50` (branch `bom`, written 2026-10-08T12:27:18). Re-generate it with each new gate baseline (docs/agentlib/TESTING.md).

The audit is the gate's: `spiderpig audit --no-sim` (the linkage family's pin loads, not the design's own MuJoCo loads), so its strength verdict can differ from a full `mise run audit`.
